description: Team projects, tasks, and safe Git workflows
configuration.title: Team
configuration.simpleMode: Show the safe simplified Git workflow for people who do not use Git commands directly
configuration.demoMode: Demo mode: show sample team data when the server is unavailable
configuration.uiLanguage: Panel language: auto (the IDE language switch, then the IDE), ru or en
container.title: Team
configuration.autoStartServer: Automatically start the local team server if it is not running (only for localhost serverUrl)
configuration.syncMode.ask: Ask — after saving files, suggest a commit message (Enter — commit and push, Esc — postpone)
configuration.syncMode.auto: Automatic — commit and push without asking
configuration.syncAutoPush: Automatically commit and push all changes after saving files (legacy — use auraTeam.sync.mode)
configuration.syncIntervalSeconds: How often to pull changes from GitHub (seconds)
configuration.syncCommitTemplate: Commit message template for auto-push. Supports {files} and {date}
configuration.gitTestCommand: Command for the 'Run tests' button in the team process (empty — detect automatically: npm test, cargo test, go test, pytest, make test)
configuration.uiLanguage.auto: Aura language switch (aura.language), otherwise the IDE language
